An Arabian-inspired Bollywood soirée under the stars, with live belly and fire dancers all night. Read below: An open-air experience...

About this Event

This is a reimagined Arabian-inspired Bollywood soirée under the stars, set across an open-air patio filled with music, movement and fire.
Picture warm night air, upscale Arabian energy, breathtaking belly dancers and thrilling fire performances unfolding throughout the night. Same signature High On Bolly energy—now in an entirely new atmosphere.

THE MUSICAt the heart of the night is a high-energy musical journey created to keep you dancing:
The latest Bollywood anthemsCurated EDM and Afro House setsHip-Hop favoritesTrending TikTok hitsSing-along classics and late-night dance-floor bangersFrom Bollywood vocals and explosive drops to hypnotic Afro House grooves, our DJs will keep the patio moving all night.

MORE THAN A PARTY—A LIVE EXPERIENCEBe mesmerized by breathtaking belly-dance performances and feel the heat as spectacular fire shows light up the open sky.
These performances are not simply happening around the party—they are part of the party.
If you experienced our previous edition, get ready to see it transformed. If you missed it, this is your chance to discover what everyone was talking about.

Dress your best in upscale evening attire, bring your favorite people and leave your worries at the door.Come for the music. Stay for the performances. Leave with stories you will still be talking about long after the lights go down.

IMPORTANT EVENT INFORMATION
Age Requirement: Strictly 21+ 🛑
A valid physical government-issued photo ID or passport is required. Photocopies, photographs and digital IDs will not be accepted. The venue strictly enforces this policy.

ALL SALES ARE FINAL — NO REFUNDS
